title: Another Main Station
author: SmartTab Support Team
synopsis: It's a Friday afternoon, and you're pulling the SmartTab van up to Monroe. Again. The last main station got broken, and Payam the bartender swears he didn't drop it. Your job: swap in ANOTHER new main station, get the Dynaflexes paired back up, and get out before the rush. Then Chad the Toast rep walks in. A comedy one-shot for 1-4 SmartTab reps at level 1 (about 30 minutes); bar staff fill a small crew.

am_start.title: Friday Afternoon at Monroe
am_start.text:
It's a Friday afternoon, and you're pulling the SmartTab van up to MONROE. Again.

The last main station got broken. Payam the bartender swears he didn't drop it.

Your job: swap in ANOTHER new main station, get the Dynaflexes paired back up, and get out before the rush.

choices.label: Grab the tool bag and head inside

effects.text: You stuff a couple of Monsters and a basket of fries from yesterday into your tool bag. Professional.

am_back_office.title: The Back Office
am_back_office.text:
You walk in, wave to Payam at the bar, and drop the old broken main station on the bar on your way past.

In the back office, the new main station is still in the box.

choices.label: Swap in the new main station and pair the Dynaflexes, the iPads and the iPhones

pass.text: The new main station boots up first try, and every Dynaflex pairs right away! The manager signs off on the install and pays you 25,000 gold.

fail.text: The power strip under the desk sparks while you plug in the new main station! It boots up on the second try. The manager pays you 15,000 gold.

choices.label: Run a full diagnostic on Monroe's network first

effects.text: The diagnostic comes back clean. You swap in the new main station and the Dynaflexes pair up. You know this network cold now (Heroic Inspiration). The manager pays you 20,000 gold for the install.

asides: Every rep has a Monroe. This is yours.

am_meanwhile.title: Meanwhile, at the Bar
am_meanwhile.text:
While you're in the back, the front door opens.

Chad, the Toast rep, walks in, grabs a seat at the bar, and orders a drink like he lives there. He sees the SmartTab van out front. Then he sees the old broken main station sitting on the bar.

"Payam, my man. Is that ANOTHER broken SmartTab station? Toast hardware doesn't break like that. I'll get you six months free and beat whatever they're charging. Their support? Good luck. You'll be on hold till Christmas."

Payam just keeps pouring drinks and doesn't say anything.

npc.name: Chad
npc.title: The Toast Rep
npc.line: Payam, my man. Is that ANOTHER broken SmartTab station?

choices.label: Back in the office, you realize you need more gear…

am_van.title: The Van
am_van.text:
You slip out the kitchen door to the SmartTab van and haul the back doors open. Everything a rep could need, and some things nobody needs, is in here somewhere.

(Gear you grab goes into your pack. Open your character sheet to **attune** to the iPad, POS Bank, Dynaflex or iPhones — up to three at once.)

choices.label: Gas station hot dog — 2,000 gold (+10 Uptime)

effects.text: You eat a gas station hot dog that's been in the van since Tuesday.

choices.label: Spare iPad — 3,000 gold (more Bandwidth)

effects.text: You grab a spare iPad for the new main station.

choices.label: POS Bank — 5,000 gold (more Max Uptime)

effects.text: You grab a fresh POS bank to charge the iPhones and Dynaflexes.

choices.label: Monster Energy — 1,500 gold

effects.text: You shove a Monster in your pocket.

choices.label: Spare Dynaflex — 6,000 gold (+1 attack, +2 damage)

effects.text: You pair a spare Dynaflex to a backup iPhone and clip it to your belt.

choices.label: Box of iPhones — 4,000 gold (+3 Signal)

effects.text: You grab a box of iPhones for the servers.

choices.label: Close up the van and head back inside

effects.text: You slam the van doors and head back in through the kitchen.

asides: Nobody knows how long that hot dog has been in the van. Nobody asks.

am_trash_talk.title: The Trash Talk
am_trash_talk.text:
You walk out of the back office with your tool bag… and hear Chad talking trash about SmartTab to Payam.

Chad spins around on his bar stool. "Oh look, it's the guy who keeps breaking Payam's stations."

It's on. **Three rounds.** Every comeback that lands rattles him before the fight starts.

am_brawl_start.title: The Bar Fight
am_brawl_start.text:
Chad stands up, knocks your tool bag off the bar, and shoves you.

You shove him back. A bar stool goes over. Then everything starts flying.

(Your phone has SmartTab Support on speed dial — **one call per fight**. Monsters and fries heal you as a Bonus Action.)

choices.label: Throw down!
Throw down!

am_game_over.title: Game Over — Monroe Switches to Toast
am_game_over.text:
Chad lands the last hit and you go down on the bar mat.

Payam, holding a bag of ice to his head, sighs and hands Chad a Toast contract to leave on the bar.

**=== GAME OVER — Monroe switches to Toast ===**

choices.label: Run it back (try the fight again)
Accept defeat and end the tale

am_aftermath.title: The Aftermath
am_aftermath.text:
Chad limps out the front door, mumbling that he's "emailing corporate."

Payam sits on the ice machine with a bag of ice on his head. The manager comes out of the back, looks at the mess, and asks who threw the main station.

Nobody says anything.

Payam finally speaks up: "Good news. It was the old one. It was already broken." The manager thinks about it for a second, shrugs, and signs Monroe up for another year of SmartTab.

**=== YOU WIN — MONROE STAYS SMARTTAB ===**

am_brawl.title: Bar Fight at Monroe
am_brawl.intro: Chad throws pint glasses, bar stools and limes, and tackles people into the beer cooler. Knock him out (nobody dies in a bar fight). Use your SmartTab Support call, chug a Monster when you need it — and watch out for the old main station.

phases.text: In the chaos, Chad grabs the OLD broken main station you left on the bar. You grab the other end — a tug of war — and you both let go at the exact same time. It spins across the bar and… BONK! It hits Payam right in the head. The whole room goes silent. A second later Payam pops back up holding a bag of ice, points straight at Chad, and whips him with a wet bar rag!

monsters.name: Chad the Toast Rep
monsters.blurb: The Toast rep. Shirt tucked into his jeans. Six months free, then fifteen years of contract.

monsters.name: Chad the Toast Rep (Confident)
monsters.blurb: He won the trash talk 3-0, and he will not stop mentioning it.

monsters.name: Bowl of Limes
monsters.blurb: Chad threw it. It's still somehow attacking you.

monsters.name: Toast Sales Intern
monsters.blurb: Chad brought backup. It's his first week. He has been told this is 'a team-building exercise'.

items.name: Monster Energy
items.desc: Crack it and chug it. Restores 10 Uptime (hit points). Bonus Action.

items.name: Basket of Fries
items.desc: Stolen off the bar. Restores 5 Uptime (hit points). Bonus Action.

items.name: SmartTab Support (on speaker)
items.desc: Once per fight: call SmartTab Support on speaker. They pick up on the first ring and roast Toast so hard the whole bar goes "OHHHH." Ranged attack (20 ft): 2d8 psychic damage to the target's ego.

items.name: Spare iPad
items.desc: For the new main station. More Bandwidth: +1 to spell attacks and spell save DC, +1 initiative.

items.name: POS Bank
items.desc: Charges the iPhones and Dynaflexes — and you. +5 Max Uptime (hit points) per level.

items.name: Spare Dynaflex
items.desc: Paired to a backup iPhone and clipped to your belt. +1 to weapon attack rolls and +2 to weapon damage.

items.name: Box of iPhones
items.desc: For the servers. Better Signal: +3 to Charisma checks (Persuasion, Deception, Performance, Intimidation).

pregens.name: The Drive Smasher
pregens.appearance: SmartTab polo, tool bag, and the calm of someone who has never met a hard drive he couldn't break.
pregens.personality: Balanced. Good at everything, great at nothing, and somehow always the one they send to Monroe.

pregens.name: MR janitor JD
pregens.appearance: SmartTab polo, a mop he refuses to explain, and more Uptime than anyone in the van.
pregens.personality: Cleans up every mess: cable runs, bar floors, other people's installs.
pregens.motto: I'll clean it up. I always clean it up.

pregens.name: Larson Jr
pregens.appearance: SmartTab polo, three chargers, and the most Bandwidth in the company.
pregens.personality: Treats every network like a puzzle and every puzzle like a personal challenge.
pregens.motto: Have you tried turning it off and on again? I have. Twice.

pregens.name: Vijay
pregens.appearance: SmartTab polo, perfect posture, and the strongest Signal in the van.
pregens.personality: Can pair any device and win any argument. Usually at the same time.

pregens.name: Dre
pregens.appearance: SmartTab polo with the sleeves rolled up. Hits harder; has a little less Uptime to spare.
pregens.personality: Quiet until somebody insults the product.

pregens.name: Rosa, Monroe's Line Cook
pregens.appearance: Kitchen whites, a fry basket, and the patience of someone who has worked a Friday rush.
pregens.personality: Patches everybody up with fries and opinions. Has never once liked Chad.

pregens.name: Big Ray, Monroe's Door Guy
pregens.appearance: Six and a half feet of black T-shirt that says STAFF.
pregens.personality: Checks IDs, breaks up fights, and is very tired of Toast reps.
